ios-data-display|Gauges.summary: The Plenix gauge on iOS is SwiftUI’s Gauge in the accessoryCircular style or a semicircle drawn the Plenix way: the track in the subtle border color, the fill in the first data-viz color, the value in DM Mono in the middle, the ends under the arc, and, with thresholds, the warning and critical ranges and a status label. Gauge keeps its own accessibility (its value and range read by VoiceOver).

anatomy.name: Track
anatomy.about: The whole range, in the subtle border color.

anatomy.name: Fill
anatomy.about: From the start of the range to the value, in the first data-viz color.

anatomy.name: Value
anatomy.about: The value in DM Mono in the middle of the arc, with a few words under it.

anatomy.name: Ends
anatomy.about: The minimum and the maximum under the ends of the arc, in DM Mono.

anatomy.name: Threshold ranges
anatomy.about: The warning and critical ranges outside the track, in the alert colors.

anatomy.name: Status
anatomy.about: The name of the range the value is in, with its icon, so color is never the only cue.
